nodes.label: Launch Intake
nodes.annotation: Campaign brief and assets enter the review queue.

nodes.label: Ops Triage
nodes.annotation: Operations assigns owners and validates deadlines.

nodes.label: Creative Review
nodes.annotation: Messaging, visual hierarchy, and asset variants are checked.

nodes.label: Brand Review
nodes.annotation: Brand consistency and policy alignment are confirmed.

nodes.label: Regional Review
nodes.annotation: Local market teams confirm timing and required adaptations.

nodes.label: Exec Summary
nodes.annotation: Leadership sees blockers, readiness, and next approvals.

nodes.label: Launch Sign-off
nodes.annotation: The launch package is approved for go-live.

nodes.label: Rework Loop
nodes.annotation: Blocked assets return with explicit requested changes.
